SPECTRAL FLUID

#Project 02　 #Interaction Design

Digital Remains / Slow Interaction

SPECTRAL

FLUID

A quieter way to remember

An interactive intelligent object for remembrance

Spectral Fluid explores how digital traces can become a quiet, tangible ritual of

remembrance. A personal memory archive, a responsive fluid object and a companion

app connect meaningful records with everyday life.

Touch, fluid and light translate selected memories into an abstract physical response.

The app supports setup, curation and personal preferences; a complete use journey

supports everyday ownership.
